answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 28577 Country: United Kingdom Title: A lady relative suddenly went like mad woman, i prayed tahajjud & made dua for her,then went to sleep. i dreamed i was in sleeping position and she came towards me and dissolved in me (like she submitted her life to me) Whats the meaning please? Question: RE: Dream Assalamu alaikum a lady relative suddenly went like mad woman, i prayed tahajjud & made dua for her,then went to sleep. i dreamed i was in sleeping position and she came towards me and dissolved in me (like she submitted her life to me) Whats the meaning please? Jazakallah Answer ID: 28577 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 124/96/H=1432) It means that your dua benefited her and so is hoped in future as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
